finding: Replayed journal claim with malformed active leaseUntil (null, numeric string, object) was treated as expired by JavaScript coercion, releasing a potentially active worker and appending requeue events. One malformed entry could cause partial recovery.
repair: Preflight all active leases for safe-integer leaseUntil before any recovery append; reject malformed entries without changing journal; retain normal expired/unexpired recovery.

verification.environment: V8 source-execution harness using exact GitHub readback and in-memory append-only journal mocks; not Node native test runner
verification.baseline: 3 malformed lease cases prematurely requeued tickets and wrote journal

numeric string deadline blocked without journal change
object deadline blocked without journal change
